p: Sarai Abram's wife bare him no: It seems that she had respect for God's promise, which could not be accomplished without issue.
restrained me from bearing: She fails by limiting God's power to the common order of nature, as though God could not give her children in her old age.
despised in her eyes: This punishment declares what they gain if they attempt any thing against the word of God.
angel of the LORD found her: Which was Christ, as appears in Ge 16:13,18:17.
Return to thy mistress: God rejects no estate of people in their misery, but sends them comfort.
he shall dwell in the presence: That is, the Ishmaelites will be a separate people by themselves and not part of another people.
Have I also here looked after: She rebukes her own dullness and acknowledges God's graces, who was present with her everywhere.
